EVENT NAME: JERSEY CITY BOARD OF EDUCATION CAUCUS
NEWSLETTER DESCRIPTION: TEMPERS FLARE AT THE JERSEY CITY BOARD OF EDUCATION CAUCUS WITH A SPEAKER REMOVED FROM THE MEETING.
DESCRIPTION: TEMPERS FLARED AT TUESDAY’S JERSEY CITY BOARD OF EDUCATION CAUCUS WHEN THE BOARD’S VICE PRESIDENT CUT A FORMER SCHOOL DISTRICT CLERK’S REMARKS SHORT AND ORDERED HER REMOVED FROM THE MEETING. THE EX-EMPLOYEE, MARY CORDERO, ATTEMPTED TO SPEAK DURING PUBLIC COMMENT ABOUT A REMARK BOARD PRESIDENT NOEMÍ VELÁZQUEZ MADE AT FEBRUARY’S BOARD MEETING. VELÁZQUEZ SAID TRUSTEE LORENZO RICHARDSON, WHO IS BLACK AND WAS DRESSED IN TRADITIONAL AFRICAN GARB, WAS “LOOKING LIKE SOMEBODY WHO’S COMING TO AMERICA” — A REFERENCE TO A 1988 EDDIE MURPHY FILM. RICHARDSON CALLED THE COMMENT DISRESPECTFUL AND RACIST, AND VELÁZQUEZ LATER PUBLICLY APOLOGIZED. “I HAVE COME OUT OF FORCED RETIREMENT TO ADDRESS THE BIGOTRY AND DIVISIVE ACTIONS OF THIS SCHOOL BOARD,” CORDERO SAID AT TUESDAY’S CAUCUS MEETING. VELÁZQUEZ LEFT THE ROOM A FEW SECONDS AFTER CORDERO BEGAN SPEAKING, LEAVING MORRIS TEMPORARILY IN CHARGE. A MINUTE INTO CORDERO’S REMARKS, SHORTLY AFTER SHE USED THE TERM “CRAP SHOW,” MORRIS BANGED VELÁZQUEZ’S GAVEL, AND THE BOARD’S ATTORNEY ADVISED CORDERO THAT SPEAKERS MUST REFRAIN FROM USING “CRUDE OR OBSCENE” LANGUAGE. MORRIS WARNED HER THAT IF SHE VIOLATED THE PUBLIC COMMENT POLICY AGAIN, HE WOULD CUT HER SPEAKING TIME SHORT. CORDERO CONTINUED WITH HER REMARKS, BUT AFTER SHE SAID THAT SUPERINTENDENT NORMA FERNANDEZ HAS WATCHED AS VELÁZQUEZ’S “BIGOTRY HAS REARED ITS UGLY HEAD,” MORRIS BANGED THE GAVEL AGAIN. CORDERO ASKED WHAT SHE HAD SAID THAT VIOLATED THE COMMENT POLICY, BUT MORRIS DID NOT ANSWER. WHEN CORDERO CONTINUED TO STAND AT THE PODIUM AND VOCALLY PROTEST, MORRIS TOLD HER SHE WAS TRESPASSING AND MOTIONED FOR THE SCHOOL DISTRICT’S SECURITY DIRECTOR TO ESCORT HER FROM THE ROOM. AS SHE WAS LEAVING, CORDERO SHOUTED: “FIRST AMENDMENT! THAT’S WHY YOU WERE LET GO FROM BEING A COP. YOU’RE A BAD PERSON. I’LL SAY IT ON FACEBOOK, AND TIKTOK, AND EVERYWHERE ELSE, BECAUSE I’VE GOT TO STATE THE TRUTH.”
